subtasks: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.

Complete the lower layer first: identify the large board and place it centered across the two upright white supports already on the table, using one support that started on the left and one that started on the right. Preserve each support’s broad-face bearing and original upper face, align the board’s long edges, stabilize it, and leave all other pieces untouched.

Use the right gripper to put the farther right white support on the clear table about 23 cm to the right of the repositioned left white support, at the same front-to-back position. Keep its upper face up. Leave both boards and the other supports in place.

Pick up the longest pale wooden board lying between the white blocks and the smaller board. Keep it horizontal and place it centered across the two inner white supports behind it. Release it and lift clear.
